description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case for testing the link rendering functionality of the Markdown content type in the Daux documentation generator. It verifies the correct transformation of Markdown link syntax into HTML anchor elements with various URL types and formats.

classes.name: LinkRendererTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing the link rendering functionality within Markdown content for the Daux documentation project.

methods.name: providerRenderLink
methods.description: Provides a set of test data consisting of expected HTML output, Markdown link strings, and current page paths for testing the link conversion logic.

methods.name: testRenderLink
methods.description: Executes the test using the data from providerRenderLink to ensure Markdown links are correctly converted to HTML within the given project context.
